newsitem.title: UK: Shell keeps four Brents, fifth in dispute - trade.
newsitem.headline: Shell keeps four Brents, fifth in dispute - trade.

text.p: Four of five Brent cargoes assigned loading dates on Friday were kept from the paper chains but the fifth was being disputed, dealers said.

The four cargoes, due to load May 3-5 (x2), May 4-6 and May 5-7, were kept by oil major Shell. China's Sinochem and U.S. major Texaco were disputing ownership of the fifth, also due to load May 5-7, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
